facts.fact: Economist Seydou Bocoum writes that law no. 2025-15 of 4 September 2025 gives every citizen, legal resident and legal person the right to access information held by public bodies, with a response deadline of eight clear days, extendable to fifteen, and an appeal to the Commission nationale d'accès à l'information.

Economist Seydou Bocoum writes that the National Digital Addressing project launched in 2021 was relaunched by the Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Affairs at a workshop on 5-6 August 2026 to finish its pilot phase within a year before any national rollout, and that public sources do not establish a fully operational national reference.

systems.owner: Ministère des Télécommunications et du Numérique

SEN.note: The document discusses online authentication only as a need and states no authentication service.
The document says nothing about records passing between the civil register and the ID system.

facts.fact: Economist Seydou Bocoum cites the RGPH-5 census of the national statistics agency ANSD for 40.5% of people aged six and over being illiterate in 2023.

SEN.note: The document only says the action plan should treat personal data protection and states nothing of a law.
The document says nothing about an electronic transactions or e-commerce law.
The document names no online government service, portal or count of services.
The document gives no count or share of people holding a national ID.
The document says nothing about an ID number at birth.
The document says nothing about who operates or owns the ID system.
The document names no register keyed on the national ID number.
The document only refers to an existing biometric ID card and states nothing of how the system issues or checks identities.
